name: Lim Guan Eng
detail: Opposed wealth and inheritance taxes during tenure as Finance Minister, citing capital flight risks

name: Anwar Ibrahim
detail: Prime Minister and Finance Minister; explicitly ruled out a wealth tax, stating government focuses instead on dividend and unlisted share capital gains taxes

name: Johan Mahmood Merican
detail: Treasury Secretary-General; noted wealth tax is difficult to implement due to valuation of non-liquid assets

name: Wee Ka Siong
detail: MCA MP for Ayer Hitam, President of MCA; in Dewan Rakyat debate on 22 Oct 2018 rejected wealth tax, warning government against introducing taxes that burden the people

name: Consumers Association of Penang
detail: Pushed for reintroducing inheritance tax (estate duty abolished in 1991), which is out of definition

name: Geoffrey Williams
detail: Argued against wealth tax as difficult to enforce and prone to avoidance; proposed an e-payments tax instead

name: Yeah Kim Leng
detail: Argued against wealth tax citing lessons from France/Germany on capital flight and administrative burdens

name: Nungsari Ahmad Radhi
detail: Focused on base broadening, VAT/GST reintroduction and fiscal discipline; has not called for a wealth tax

name: Liew Chin Tong
detail: Deputy Minister of Finance; emphasized personal income and corporate tax reform while cautioning against consumption taxes; no wealth tax endorsement

name: Mohd Afzanizam Abdul Rashid
detail: Chief Economist at Bank Muamalat Malaysia; argued in May 2026 against wealth tax, citing high top personal income tax rates (up to 30%) and preferring subsidy reviews

name: William Ng
detail: National President of SAMENTA; strongly opposed 2% wealth tax proposal, warning of capital flight and talent loss to Singapore

name: Muhammed Abdul Khalid
detail: Economist and author of The Colour of Inequality; prominent advocate for inheritance tax (estate duty) and capital gains tax, but has not endorsed a recurring net wealth tax

name: Chin Chee Seong
detail: National President of SME Association of Malaysia; stated introducing a wealth tax would trigger capital flight to Singapore and harm business confidence

name: Wong Chen
detail: PKR MP for Subang; advocates for comprehensive Capital Gains Tax on unlisted shares and corporate assets and higher top-bracket personal income tax, but does not propose or support an annual net wealth tax

name: Ong Kian Ming
detail: Former DAP MP for Bangi and Deputy Minister of MITI; co-authored Pakatan alternative budgets proposing Capital Gains Tax and Inheritance Tax, but has not endorsed a recurring net wealth tax
